placeholderImages.name: Aviatur - E-commerce Web Site
placeholderImages.description: Comprehensive travel and booking platform for one of the largest travel agencies in the region.
placeholderImages.goal: Modernize the online booking experience and integrate multiple travel services into a single platform.
placeholderImages.overview: Aviatur, a leader in the Colombian travel market, faced the challenge of consolidating its vast catalog of flights, hotels, and tours into a unified digital experience. The legacy system was plagued by high technical debt and a fragmented user interface that led to significant drop-offs. The project's scope included a complete overhaul of the digital infrastructure, focusing on creating a scalable, high-performance ecosystem capable of handling millions of monthly searches while providing a personalized experience for diverse user segments, from solo travelers to corporate groups.
placeholderImages.problem: The primary pain point was a 'friction-heavy' booking engine. Users were overwhelmed by a non-intuitive information architecture, slow search results, and a checkout process that required excessive manual input. Mobile users, who represent over 60% of traffic, struggled with a non-responsive design that made completing a purchase nearly impossible on smaller screens. Additionally, the lack of real-time inventory synchronization caused frustration and lost sales due to price mismatches at the final payment stage.
placeholderImages.objective: The main objective was to design and build a 'frictionless' multi-device booking platform that simplifies the travel planning process. Key performance indicators (KPIs) included increasing the conversion rate by 25%, reducing the average time-to-purchase by 40%, and achieving a 90% mobile-readiness score. We also aimed to implement a self-service module to decrease support call volume by 15% through better user onboarding and intuitive management tools.
placeholderImages.strategy: We adopted a 'Mobile-First' and 'Atomic Design' methodology. My strategy focused on 'Progressive Disclosure'—hiding complex filtering options until the user explicitly needed them to avoid cognitive overload. We implemented a unified design system that ensured visual consistency across all booking modules. Technically, we integrated high-speed search APIs with asynchronous loading states and custom skeleton screens to maintain a perception of speed. A critical part of the strategy was the 'Single-View' dashboard, where users could manage their entire itinerary in one place.
placeholderImages.impact: The relaunch resulted in a transformative 35% increase in online bookings within the first six months. Mobile conversion rates spiked by 50%, validating the responsive-first approach. User feedback highlighted the clarity of the new interface, and the agency saw a 20% reduction in customer support inquiries related to booking errors. The platform successfully modernized Aviatur's brand image, positioning them as a digital-first leader in the competitive OTA (Online Travel Agency) space.
placeholderImages.decisions: One of the most impactful decisions was replacing the traditional 5-step checkout with a dynamic 'Single-Page Checkout' that adaptively showed only relevant fields based on the selected services. I also decided to implement a 'Smart Suggestion' engine in the search bar that used historical data to predict destinations, which alone reduced search errors by 12%. Finally, we introduced a 'Price Lock' feature, allowing users to hold a fare for 24 hours, significantly reducing stress and increasing long-term conversion through retargeting.

placeholderImages.name: Orbit Group Partners - Dashboard
placeholderImages.description: A comprehensive coaching platform designed to help users achieve their goals by tracking real-time performance metrics.
placeholderImages.goal: To overhaul the user experience by implementing WCAG accessibility standards and creating a robust Design System.
placeholderImages.role: Lead UI/UX Designer, Design System Architecture
placeholderImages.overview: Orbit Group Partners provides executive-level coaching and productivity tools to global enterprises. Their platform, however, was struggling to translate complex behavioral data into actionable insights for managers. I led the design transformation of their primary SaaS dashboard, focusing on creating a high-fidelity 'command center' for leadership. The project required a deep understanding of organizational psychology and data visualization best practices to ensure that the interface not only displayed data but told a meaningful story about team health and individual growth.
placeholderImages.problem: The existing dashboard suffered from 'Data Fatigue.' Executives were presented with walls of raw numbers and static charts that required manual interpretation. There was no clear hierarchy of information, and critical performance alerts were often missed. Furthermore, the platform lacked basic accessibility features, alienating users with visual impairments and violating corporate compliance standards. Inconsistency in UI components across different modules led to a steep learning curve for new users.
placeholderImages.objective: The core objective was to design a centralized, accessible, and highly intuitive dashboard that prioritizes Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). We aimed for 100% compliance with WCAG 2.1 AA standards. Our success metrics were defined by a 50% reduction in 'time-to-insight' (the time it takes a user to understand a metric) and a significant increase in daily active usage among senior leadership, who previously avoided the tool due to its complexity.
placeholderImages.strategy: I developed a comprehensive Design System from the ground up, utilizing a modular 'Grid System' and a carefully curated color palette designed specifically for data visualization clarity. The strategy relied heavily on 'Visual Hierarchy'—using size, color, and placement to guide the user's eye to the most critical metrics first. We integrated D3.js for interactive, real-time data visualizations that allowed users to 'drill down' into specifics without leaving the main view. A 'Contextual Help' system was also implemented to provide immediate guidance on complex metrics.
placeholderImages.impact: The redesigned platform was met with universal praise from Orbit's corporate clients. We achieved a 60% improvement in task completion speed and a 45% increase in user engagement scores. The platform became a selling point for Orbit's coaching services, directly contributing to a 20% growth in their SaaS subscription revenue. Most importantly, the dashboard successfully empowered managers to make data-driven decisions that improved overall team productivity.
placeholderImages.decisions: I made the strategic decision to adopt a 'Dark Mode' default for the dashboard to reduce eye strain for executives who spend long hours on the platform. I also implemented a 'Customizable Widget' system, allowing users to tailor their personal view to their specific management style. A key UX decision was the 'Metric Normalization' feature, which translated abstract coaching scores into a simple 0-100 scale, making it instantly understandable across different international departments.

placeholderImages.name: Tecnologia Mayorista
placeholderImages.description: A comprehensive e-commerce platform for a major technology wholesaler.
placeholderImages.goal: To boost online sales by optimizing the user experience through in-depth user research and customer journey mapping.
placeholderImages.role: UX Research, Customer Journey Mapping, UI Design
placeholderImages.overview: Tecnologia Mayorista is a dominant player in the tech distribution market in Colombia. As part of their digital transformation, they needed to move from a traditional, manual wholesale ordering process to a modern, automated B2B e-commerce platform. I led the UX strategy and UI design, focusing on the unique needs of bulk buyers who value speed, accuracy, and transparent pricing. The project involved mapping complex B2B purchasing workflows and translating them into a seamless digital experience on the Shopify Plus platform.
placeholderImages.problem: The transition from offline to online was hindered by an antiquated ordering system. Wholesale buyers were frustrated by the inability to see dynamic pricing based on their order volume, the lack of real-time stock levels, and a cumbersome search process for technical products. The previous site was not optimized for mobile, which was a critical failure for warehouse managers and small business owners who needed to order on the go. The 'Time to Order' was too high, leading many long-term clients to stick to inefficient phone orders.
placeholderImages.objective: Our goal was to transition 40% of traditional phone/email orders to the online platform within the first year. We aimed to simplify the wholesale journey, reducing the time to place a bulk order by 60%. Specific objectives included implementing a multi-tier pricing engine, an advanced technical search system, and a robust mobile experience that mirrored the efficiency of the desktop version.
placeholderImages.strategy: My strategy was rooted in deep 'Stakeholder Interviews' and 'User Shadowing' to understand the daily routines of bulk buyers. We designed a 'Quick Order' interface that allowed users to add hundreds of SKUs to their cart via a CSV upload or a rapid search-and-add tool. The UI focused on high-density information display, prioritizing specifications and stock status over purely aesthetic imagery. We built a custom pricing logic into the Shopify backend that calculated discounts in real-time as the user increased quantities, providing immediate gratification and transparency.
placeholderImages.impact: The results exceeded all expectations. Within nine months, 55% of all wholesale orders were being placed online, surpassing our initial target. The average order value (AOV) increased by 15% due to the transparent tier-pricing engine, which encouraged buyers to 'hit the next level' for better discounts. Support calls related to stock availability dropped by 70%, and the platform became the primary growth driver for the company, enabling them to scale their operations without increasing headcount in sales support.
placeholderImages.decisions: A pivotal decision was to prioritize a 'Matrix Order' view for products with multiple variants (like RAM or storage sizes), allowing buyers to enter quantities for all variants on a single screen rather than clicking into each one. I also decided to implement a 'Wholesale-only' access layer, ensuring that sensitive bulk pricing was only visible to verified business partners. Finally, we introduced an 'Automated Quote' feature that allowed users to convert their cart into a PDF quote for internal approval, bridging the gap between digital ordering and corporate procurement processes.
